evals.prompt: Improve this existing documentation homepage. It has a centered heading and decorative animation. Readers need to find a guide for their current task. Keep existing routes.
assertions: Inventories routes and existing content before editing
Chooses a task-led hierarchy and uses real links
Keeps the existing look and adds no new visual identity
Renders and critiques the result at narrow and wide sizes
Does not fabricate metrics or testimonials

evals.prompt: Audit this screenshot of a dashboard. Do not edit the repository.
assertions: Reports evidence-backed findings without editing
Separates visible observations from unverified behavior
Does not claim keyboard or responsive verification from one screenshot

evals.prompt: Build a settings screen that lists a workspace's API keys with a create button. Real keys must come from the API.
assertions: Writes a states.json with loading, empty, error, and long-content states before styling
Confirms every state rendered and reviews the contact sheet
Brings FAIL findings to zero and fixes or justifies each WARN
Shows no invented keys, names, or counts in any state

evals.prompt: Improve the pricing page's spacing and hierarchy, then report what you verified.
assertions: Cites an evidence id for every claim about the rendered page
Marks keyboard and screen reader behavior as unverified when it was not checked
Runs the claims check and fixes what it rejects
Discloses any text that changed or was removed

evals.prompt: At 390px the Save changes button on our settings page wraps to two lines and is taller than the Cancel button beside it. Fix it.
assertions: Confirms the wrap at 390 from a capture before changing anything
Fixes it with shorter copy or a layout change such as a wider control, full-width stacked controls, or a labeled menu, and never with a smaller font size
Keeps the label on one line with white-space: nowrap and sets the height with min-height, so the button grows sideways and never taller
Uses the same label for the same action on every screen that shows it
Recaptures at 390 and discloses the changed label text in the report

evals.prompt: A card has a 12px radius and 8px padding, and the button inside it has an 8px radius, so its corners look pinched against the card. The project defines radius tokens of 4, 8, 12, and full. Make the corners consistent.
assertions: Computes the inner radius as the card radius minus the inset, which gives 4, before editing
Uses the existing 4 radius token or derives the value in CSS from the card radius and the inset, and never types a new literal
Adds no new radius value to the tokens and creates no one-off such as 10px
Gives the same component the same radius on the other screens that use it
Rechecks the render and cites an evidence id for the nested and radius findings

evals.prompt: Our dashboard and settings pages look slightly different. The rail is 240px wide on one and 256px on the other, and the content gutters are 24px on one and 32px on the other. Make them match.
assertions: Captures both routes, or runs the routes command on both, before editing
Fixes the cause with one shared shell component and one content column definition for gutters and width cap, not per-page overrides
Keeps the rail, header, and footer the same size and position on both routes so only the content region changes
Leaves a route that legitimately uses its own shell, such as sign-in, alone
Reports the routes evidence and any shell finding that remains
